  B)         Discuss the search user experience in the case of an e-commerce website.                  (5)  
  5)              A news aggregation platform is building a specialized crawler to collect articles from  
  50,000 news websites. The platform faces the following challenges:  
  
  A)            • 30% of articles are duplicated (e.g., syndicated content, republished press  
  releases).  
  • Dynamic loading (e.g., JavaScript-rendered content) causes the crawler to miss  
  key text.  
  • Rate-limiting by news sites leads to incomplete data collection.  
  • Server overload occurs when crawling large multimedia articles (videos, high-res (5)  
  images).  
  
  Implement a crawling strategy that:  
  
  1. Minimizes duplicate content storage.  
  2. Handles dynamic content effectively.  
  3. Avoids being blocked by news websites.  
  
  
  B)         Describe how to minimize unnecessary crawling without compromising content  
  coverage.                                                                                 (5)  
  
  
  -----End-----
